beats.setting_description: After obtaining the glyphs of sorrow, remembrance, and legacy. You meet Ravi in the desert right outside the marketplace. He looks at you and mixed emotions.
beats.prompt: Oh...hi again Lioren. For some reason, I thought you might've actually left by now. Most people can't cut it out here.

tone_choices.label: Trust
tone_choices.text: I can tell this place has been full of confusion and odd characters.
tone_choices.npc_response: Oh... Anyone that I should be worried about? I saw Kaelen lurking about keep your wits about you with that guy. I try not to prejudge people, but...

tone_choices.label: Observation
tone_choices.text: I can see why this place has a harshness to it that I'm not used to, I'm not sure how I feel about some of the people I've met, but I'm trying to be open.
tone_choices.npc_response: Hm... hearing that does concern me a little bit being a guard and all. You would let me know if you saw or heard anything right.

tone_choices.label: Narrative
tone_choices.text: To be honest, I have a lot more questions that I need answered before I think about leaving. Not to mention, I didn't come all this way just to run back home.
tone_choices.npc_response: Well, they say fortune favors the bold. But I would add not the foolish. Have you thought about what you might do for food and shelter and all that?

tone_choices.label: Empathy
tone_choices.text: Yeah... I'm actually surprised you and Nima are still here given what you know I've heard about your situation. I'm sorry by the way. I wish I could offer more.
tone_choices.npc_response: Well... At least you seem genuine we need more people like that. As far as what you can offer, I suppose you can't change the past,but try not to add any more misery to the future.

tone_choices.label: Trust
tone_choices.text: No, not really.

tone_choices.label: Observation
tone_choices.text: Not yet.

tone_choices.label: Narrative
tone_choices.text: Just a few colorful characters, nothing too concerning.

tone_choices.label: Empathy
tone_choices.text: If there were any concerning characters, I would let you know.

tone_choices.label: Trust
tone_choices.text: Sure.

tone_choices.label: Observation
tone_choices.text: I'm sure you mean saw or heard something sketchy. If that's the case then yes.

tone_choices.label: Narrative
tone_choices.text: If I feel like something is concerning, then I will let you know.

tone_choices.label: Empathy
tone_choices.text: I see you take your role seriously so yes of course I will do what I can to help.

tone_choices.label: Trust
tone_choices.text: I've thought about it. Daily. I just haven't really met anyone that seemed willing or able to provide those.

tone_choices.label: Observation
tone_choices.text: Of course, I need to survive after all.

tone_choices.label: Narrative
tone_choices.text: That's the reason I even came to the marketplace... So far no luck though.

tone_choices.label: Empathy
tone_choices.text: It's definitely been on my mind. Hoping I can get established soon so I'm not digging around for scraps.

tone_choices.label: Trust
tone_choices.text: To be honest, I'm not sure. I feel a little bit lost these days and overwhelmed. When my mom told me to go east I honestly didn't know what to expect.
tone_choices.npc_response:
Yeah... I get that. When Nima and I came here with each of our parents, I was terrified. She teased me so I wouldn't freeze up.
But hearing you say all this... Well... it tells me you're not reckless. Being honest about where you're at matters out here.

tone_choices.label: Observation
tone_choices.text: I'm trying to get a sense of how things work around here. The terrain, the people... I'm still piecing it together.
tone_choices.npc_response:
Hm. That's good. Most people don't pay attention when they first arrive... When Nima and I came here with each of our parents, I kept my eyes on the ground more than anything else. She said I'd miss something important if I didn't look up.
And she was right! Out here... noticing the small things keeps you safe.

tone_choices.label: Narrative
tone_choices.text: I think my first step is getting my bearings. I need to understand this place and figure out who I can actually trust.
tone_choices.npc_response: That's smart. Out here, knowing who stands where matters more than you think. I guess, keep your head clear and your eyes open...

tone_choices.label: Empathy
tone_choices.text: I feel torn about what to do next. I need to survive out here... but it's hard to ignore how much people seem to be carrying. It makes everything feel heavier.
tone_choices.npc_response: Yeah... it does get heavy. You need to focus on you and... helping others sometimes comes back to help or hurt you... I'm surprised that you notice. Most folks just deal with what's in front of them.

tone_choices.label: Trust
tone_choices.text: Continue

tone_choices.label: Trust
tone_choices.text: Continue

tone_choices.label: Trust
tone_choices.text: Continue
